about: The vacuity checker names what a predicate does over the valuations it samples: it discriminates, with a witness on each side; it holds whatever the valuation; or it never reads one.
The predicates are code a file cannot hold; they are built beside the test, and this file names each by the verdict it must draw.

coverage.criterion: one predicate for each verdict the checker can draw
coverage.why: one chain of nine levels; the checker samples its valuations, so the verdicts are what it must see in any sample
